title: Online-Offline GPU Co-Location & Opportunistic Backfill Selection: Priority-Preemptive KV-Watermark Backfill vs. Siloed Clusters

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Siloed Dedicated Clusters (48 Online GPUs + 16 Offline Batch GPUs = 64 GPUs)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Air-gapped environments where online and offline workloads cannot share pods

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Un-Isolated Shared FIFO Queue (Online + Offline Mixed on 48 GPUs)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Anti-pattern (offline batch requests starve online users and spike P99 TTFT by 12.7x)

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Coarse CronHPA Day/Night Pod Reallocation (Nightly Offline Swap on 48 GPUs)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Predictable diurnal workloads with zero daytime batch urgency

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): KV-Watermark-Gated Opportunistic Backfill + vLLM Priority Preemption (48 GPUs Total)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Production AI Gateway + vLLM pool harvesting both daytime micro-valleys & night idle capacity (-$50.8k/mo)
